name: hashira-npm-release-dry-run-fixture
description: Static fixture for the npm-release dry-run self-CI jobs. Each job `npm pack`s this directory into a .tgz, uploads it under its own artifact name, then invokes the npm-release composite with HASHIRA_NPM_RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1, which skips the artifact download, tarball locate, `npm publish` and tag/release steps. The jobs cover the input checks, toolchain floors and auth-mode branching, not the artifact handoff. 'private: true' is harmless here (npm publish --dry-run/no-op paths never inspect it), kept for defense-in-depth in case this fixture is ever packed by a tool that does.
